notes: The session's web-search allowance ran out after five searches (the five legislative candidates), so the rest was read directly, one page at a time, with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py) and each site's robots.txt obeyed: the campaign sites filed with the Secretary of State (learned from sl_websites in the database, opened read-only), each county's, city's and school district's own site, the Minnesota DFL's endorsed list, the Legislative Reference Library and two news stories.

Nothing found, and left blank (11 of 30): Mark Titera (Clearwater County's site: robots.txt forbids our reader), Donn Hoffman (Hubbard County: robots.txt), Matthew C. Stinson (Wabasha County: robots.txt), Julie Laue (Martin County's District 4 page names Richard Koons as the sitting commissioner), Scott Zettervall, Jim Lohan, Colleen Bakken (Bemidji schools' site refused the TLS handshake), Connie Schulz, Benjamin Pecarina, Jacob Fischmann (the Judicial Branch's site is behind a bot check and was not asked), Todd M. Fellman (his filed site, toddfellmanforjudge.com, answered a plain reader with an empty page).

Nels Pierson's Republican endorsement for 2026 was reported by KAAL-TV, but no page of the party's own was found, so it is not recorded as endorsed_by. Ruth Bittner and David Torgelson: no campaign site was found (ruthbittner.com is a business site, not a campaign site, and is not listed).
Directory pages give no starting year for most offices, so 'from' is left empty. The Hastings page says only "Elected: 2022" for Dave Pemble, so his 'from' is left empty too (verifier).
The Koochiching, Le Sueur, Chippewa and Little Canada directory pages, the Mahnomen sheriff page and the school board pages also show contact details; none was recorded.
